string.text: The Professor from the research complex at Lake Yantar is asking you to bring him two strong gravitational artifacts - "to solidify our business relationship".
A request from the leader of Clear Sky

"You ever heard of the Grehovtsy? The cultists holed up in the Hills, near the "Brain Scorcher"? Completely unhinged bunch! And their leader, word is, isn't even human! \n \nAnyway, they've got a storage facility at their base with documents in it. And as it happens, there's something in that storage I need. A small folder - one I'm willing to pay good money for. You up for it?"
Find documents at the Sin group's base
Bring the documents to the leader of Clear Sky

A scientist from the research complex at Yantar is refusing to let me into the bunker to see Professor Gorbovsky because of his personal problems. Apparently his wife went missing during an expedition to the underground complex beneath Dark Valley. \n \nHe clearly understands she can't be saved anymore, but he wants a pendant that belonged to her as a keepsake... Do I really have to go hunting for this trinket? Or should I just tell this idiot to get out of my way?
Find the silver pendant in the laboratory beneath the Dark Valley
Bring the silver pendant to the scientist
